digest.component_or_area: DC pagination structural guard / test harness
propositions: The structural guard `test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size` scans only `transport.py` via hardcoded `_TRANSPORT_SRC` path, but commit 465d's module split relocated all `search_issues` calls to `_base.py` and `_issues.py`.
The AST predicate `_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default()` now finds zero `search_issues` call nodes in `transport.py`, causing the guard to pass unconditionally and become vacuous.
The guard lacks an anti-vacuity assertion to detect if a future module move empties the scan target again, allowing silent disarming.

Widening the scan from single `transport.py` to all `*.py` files in `adapters/jira_datacenter/` and adding a coverage assertion restores the guard's ability to catch uncapped pagination calls in any module.
